dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: Huh? Don't tell me you've forgotten who I am? Luckily, I still remember you.

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: I'm the Master of the Liyue Adventurers' Guild, although I tend to avoid involving myself in Guild-related matters and other such bothersome affairs.

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: All that interests me is news about the sword.
